title: The first time (a fantasy)
summary: This erotic novel follows Kathy, an eighteen-year-old woman, on her first sexual experience with another woman. After meeting Judy at a family party, Kathy is invited to visit her in California for the week. The story details their time together—riding horses, shopping, and intimate encounters that escalate from sensual massages to passionate lesbian sex. Through wine, seduction, and mutual desire, Kathy explores new pleasures she never imagined with men before. Judy takes on a dominant role, teaching Kathy about love between women and guiding her through each step of their week-long affair. The narrative is an explicit exploration of first-time sexual discovery, self-acceptance, and the thrill of forbidden passion.
